Matches spec scenario 11 exactly.

**Verdict: PASSED**

AC-to-evidence mapping (`scripts/crawl-github-repos.mjs`):

1. Suggestion creation with `hidden:true`/`live:false`, skip-with-reason: filter/build logic at lines 250–296 (description-or-README gate at 250–259; doc construction 272–281 with `hidden: true, live: false` at 279–280; every skip path sets `row.verdict` with a reason, e.g. 256, 266).
2. Fork/archived/self/already-listed/denylist exclusion, no suggestion created or considered: lines 224–248 (fork 224–228, archived 229–233, self 234–238, already-listed via `repoUrl` match 239–243, `EXCLUDED_REPOS` 244–248) — all `continue` before any description/README/write logic runs.
3. Existing suggestion left untouched, "skipped: already suggested": `suggestionAlreadyExists` (187–191, read-only `_id` lookup, no write) gated at 265, sets verdict `already-suggested` + reason at 266–267, `continue`s before `writeClient.create` is ever reached.
4. No-flag run prints table, writes nothing; only `--write` persists: `WRITE = process.argv.includes("--write")` (45); write branch guarded by `if (WRITE && writeClient)` (287) vs. else `"would create (dry-run)"` (295); closing dry-run notice (308–310).
5. README fallback strips headings/rules/blanks/badges **and list items**: regexes 108–111, skip-loop 121–130, paragraph-continuation loop 140–145 (stops at blank or a subsequent list item, per the ClusterExample-derived bugfix in the comment at 133–138). Verified against coin-finder, badge, and ClusterExample fixtures — all three produce the spec's expected output.
6. `originUrl` verbatim from `homepage`, omitted when absent: `if (repo.homepage) doc.originUrl = repo.homepage;` (282) — no transformation, no fallback to `html_url`.

Boundary checks: `git diff --stat HEAD` shows only `.pHive/CONTEXT.md`, `README.md`, and an unrelated metrics jsonl changed besides the new script — `next.config.ts`, `src/lib/tools.ts`, `src/lib/sanity.ts`, `src/app/page.tsx` untouched. `live: true` appears nowhere (only `live: false` and a comment). No hardcoded/logged token — `GITHUB_TOKEN`/`SANITY_API_WRITE_TOKEN` read from `process.env` only, never printed. No `GITHUB_ACCOUNT` env var/flag — hardcoded `const GITHUB_ACCOUNT = "mdostal"` (30). No new GitHub Actions workflow (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` pre-existed, untouched). CONTEXT.md and README.md diffs both correctly describe the create-only/namespace-split semantics matching the code.

No findings. Ordering, dry-run/write-gating, rate-limit-token-omission (line 69), and the two graceful-degradation scenarios (17: fails fast pre-network when `--write` lacks a token, 18: warns and continues when `NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_PROJECT_ID` is absent) all check out against the spec as well.
